2026 Thanksgiving - Offices Closed



 

 

 
 
 


 

 
 

 

 

Scott County, City and State offices will be closed Thursday, November 26, 2026 and Friday, November 27, 2026 in observation of Thanksgiving. Additionally, the General Store is closed Saturday.
